name: fuzz_crash_class
description: What a fuzz crasher did to the target.

definitions.panic: A runtime panic not covered by a narrower class.
definitions.index_out_of_range: An index or slice bound was exceeded.
definitions.nil_dereference: A nil or null pointer was dereferenced.
definitions.timeout: One input ran past the per-input time limit (hang or unbounded loop).
definitions.integer_overflow: An arithmetic overflow or wrap was detected.
definitions.memory_corruption: A sanitizer reported an out-of-bounds access, use-after-free or similar.
definitions.memory_leak: A leak sanitizer reported unreleased memory.
definitions.uncaught_exception: An exception escaped the entry point (managed runtimes).
definitions.process_exit: The target exited the process (os.Exit, abort).
definitions.invariant_violation: A property the harness asserts failed without a crash.
